sinopsis.es: En la localidad croata de Umag, el rumor de que alguien vio un oso en plena temporada de espárragos divide al pueblo. El incidente crece en las redes y pone en duda qué se vio y qué se inventó.
sinopsis.en: In the small, sleepy Mediterranean town of Umag, the unusual appearance of a bear in the midst of wild asparagus season sparks a conflict, dividing the community into skeptics and those who believe the bear truly exists. Following a small local event that spirals wildly out of proportion, the film explores the blurry lines between truth and lies in the age of social media.
